name: agent-ready-template
description: Agent-ready multi-agent repository template specification and starter files
contribution_justification: Projects on GitHub by default use issues and pull requests, as encouraged by documentation such as <https://guides.github.com/activities/contributing-to-open-source/>.
contribution_requirements_justification: Contribution requirements are documented in CONTRIBUTING.md, with coding and repository conventions in CONVENTIONS.md and agent-facing workflow requirements in AGENTS.md: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/CONVENTIONS.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/AGENTS.md
license_location_justification: Non-trivial license location file in repository: <https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/LICENSE>.
floss_license_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
floss_license_osi_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
documentation_basics_justification: Some documentation basics file contents found.
repo_public_justification: Repository on GitHub, which provides public git repositories with URLs.
repo_track_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git can track the changes, who made them, and when they were made.
repo_distributed_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues are used for public bug and enhancement reports: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/issues
report_process_justification: Non-trivial SECURITY[.md] file found file in repository: <https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/SECURITY.md>. [osps_do_02_01]
report_archive_justification: Reports and responses are archived through GitHub Issues, Pull Requests, Releases, and Security Advisories: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/issues https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/pulls https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/releases https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/security/advisories
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The vulnerability reporting process is published in SECURITY.md, including private vulnerability reporting and response expectations: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/SECURITY.md
tests_documented_added_justification: The PR template requires verification commands and test/risk notes: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/pull_request_template.md
warnings_strict_justification: ShellCheck, actionlint, Hadolint, and pin audits are part of the required check surface: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/mise.toml https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
static_analysis_justification: Static analysis is run through the committed CodeQL advanced workflow plus ShellCheck, actionlint, Hadolint, and workflow/pin audits documented in the security workflow and mise tasks: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/security-workflows.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/mise.toml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL advanced setup and shell/workflow/static checks cover common vulnerability classes for this template scope: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/security-workflows.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/mise.toml
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The template does not publish a memory-unsafe application runtime; optional Go fuzzing is still documented and run for the template harness: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/mise.toml https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.clusterfuzzlite/Dockerfile
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The template does not implement product cryptography: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md
discussion_justification: GitHub supports discussions on issues and pull requests.
hardening_justification: The template does not publish a compiled product binary or hosted application requiring runtime hardening; CI and repository hardening are documented separately: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/security-workflows.md
crypto_used_network_justification: The template does not implement a product network protocol: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md
crypto_tls12_justification: The template does not implement TLS; project distribution uses GitHub HTTPS: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/README.md
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: The template does not implement TLS client behavior: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: The template does not send private HTTP headers as product functionality: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md
installation_common_justification: The project is a repository template/spec rather than installed end-user software; users consume it by cloning or using the repository contents directly: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/README.md
dco_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires a DCO-style Signed-off-by trailer for contributions: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
governance_justification: Governance and maintainer responsibilities are documented: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md
code_of_conduct_justification: The project code of conduct is documented: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
roles_responsibilities_justification: Maintainer, contributor, and reviewer roles are documented: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md
access_continuity_justification: Solo-mode continuity is handled through a private emergency recovery procedure documented publicly without exposing recovery material: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
bus_factor_justification: Current bus factor is one. Private recovery supports continuity but is not claimed as a bus factor of two: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repoーtemplate/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-template/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
documentation_security_justification: Security policy, threat model, and security workflow documentation are maintained: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-template/blob/main/SECURITY.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-template/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-template/blob/main/docs/security-workflows.md
documentation_quick_start_justification: README quick start commands show how to use and validate the template: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-template/blob/main/README.md
documentation_current_justification: Documentation is versioned with the repository and updated with release notes and Best Practices evidence: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/openssf-best-practices.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
documentation_achievements_justification: The README links to the template-instance Best Practices status document, which links to the Best Practices project and records achieved levels and blockers: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/README.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/openssf-best-practices.md
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: The project is operated through plain Markdown and command-line documentation, avoiding a non-text-only UI requirement for core use: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/README.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/development.md
internationalization_justification: Core operator guidance is English-first and includes Japanese companion text where useful for this template instance: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/README.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/AGENTS.md
sites_password_security_justification: The project does not operate a password-based project website; repository authentication is handled by GitHub.
maintenance_or_update_justification: Maintenance and update flow is documented through Dependabot and the release process: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/release-process.md
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: Security advisories and release notes can credit reporters when appropriate: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/SECURITY.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: The vulnerability response process is documented in SECURITY.md: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/SECURITY.md
coding_standards_justification: Coding and repository standards are documented: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/CONVENTIONS.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/AGENTS.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
coding_standards_enforced_justification: CI enforces shell, workflow, Dockerfile, release-readiness, secret-scan, pin-audit, and CodeQL checks: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/mise.toml
build_standard_variables_justification: The template repository does not generate native product binaries, so compiler and linker variables such as CC, CFLAGS, CXXFLAGS, and LDFLAGS do not apply: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/README.md
build_preserve_debug_justification: The template does not publish compiled product binaries with debug symbols to preserve: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/README.md
build_non_recursive_justification: The project does not use a native recursive build system for produced software; verification uses direct mise tasks: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/mise.toml
build_repeatable_justification: The repository is a source template/spec and does not perform a product build that generates compiled deliverables; release source archives are generated by the release workflow: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml
installation_standard_variables_justific: There is no end-user installation system with install destinations such as DESTDIR; development setup is documented separately: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/development.md
installation_development_quick_justifica: README and development docs provide quick setup and validation commands: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/README.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/development.md
external_dependencies_justification: External tools and GitHub Actions dependencies are declared in mise and workflow files: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/mise.toml https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml
updateable_reused_components_justificati: Pinned actions and tool versions are updateable through Dependabot or explicit version updates: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/security-workflows.md
interfaces_current_justification: Public commands and repository interfaces are documented in README, AGENTS, and mise tasks: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/README.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/AGENTS.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/mise.toml
automated_integration_testing_justificat: CI runs repository checks on pull requests and main pushes and reports success or failure: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
regression_tests_added50_justification: The project has not had product bug-fix releases requiring a measurable 50% regression-test ratio; contribution policy still requires tests, checks, or rationale for behavior and policy changes: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/pull_request_template.md
test_statement_coverage80_justification: The repository is primarily a documentation/template contract and does not publish a product library with meaningful statement coverage: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/README.md
implement_secure_design_justification: Secure design assumptions, trust boundaries, and workflow mitigations are documented: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/security-workflows.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/architecture.md
input_validation_justification: The template does not ship a network-facing application input parser: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: The template does not implement product cryptography: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md
crypto_credential_agility_justification: The template does not process application authentication credentials or private cryptographic keys: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md
signed_releases_justification: Release artifacts for v0.1.1 and later are signed with Sigstore keyless Cosign bundles and documented verification instructions: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/release-signing.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/releases/tag/v0.1.1
version_tags_signed_justification: Release artifacts are signed with Sigstore, but version-control tags themselves are not yet claimed as cryptographically signed: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/release-signing.md
assurance_case_justification: Security requirements, trust boundaries, and mitigations are documented in the threat model, security workflows, architecture, and Best Practices evidence: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/security-workflows.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/architecture.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/openssf-best-practices.md
OSPS-VM-06.02_justification: Static analysis is run through the committed CodeQL advanced workflow plus ShellCheck, actionlint, Hadolint, and workflow/pin audits documented in the security workflow and mise tasks: https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/docs/security-workflows.md https://github.com/Anionix/agent-ready-repo-template-spec/blob/main/mise.toml [static_analysis]
